headline: Truist Reiterates Waystar Rating on Strong Bookings Growth
summary: Truist reiterated its stock rating for Waystar following robust bookings growth reported by the healthcare payments software provider.
why: Analyst rating reiterations backed by accelerating bookings metrics provide institutional validation of a software firm's sales pipeline and revenue visibility.

impacts.name: Waystar Holding Corp
impacts.why: Positive analyst coverage supported by strong sales bookings reinforces investor confidence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
